nodes.description: The SS18-SSX fusion protein incorporates into the BAF chromatin remodeling complex, displacing wild-type SS18. This alters BAF complex targeting and function, particularly affecting polycomb-mediated gene repression. The fusion protein causes eviction of BAF47 (SMARCB1) from the complex at certain genomic loci.
